concepts.title: 角的度量与旋转
concepts.summary: $180^\circ=\pi$ 弧度；同终边角相差整周。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 以 $\pi/180$ 或 $180/\pi$ 换算，按整周约化；弧长 $s=r\theta$ 必须用弧度。

en.title: Angle measure and rotations
en.summary: $180^\circ=\pi$ rad; coterminal angles differ by a whole turn.

method.title: Method
method.body: Convert with $\pi/180$ or $180/\pi$; reduce modulo one turn; use $s=r\theta$ with radians.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 用特殊三角形及符号变化；逆时针四分之一周把 (x,y) 变为 (-y,x)。

method.title: Method
method.body: Use special triangles and sign changes; a quarter turn sends (x,y) to (-y,x).

concepts.title: 三角比与反求角
concepts.summary: 终边点 (x,y) 的 r 为到原点距离。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 用 $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$、正弦 y/r、余弦 x/r、正切 y/x 及倒数；确定符号并找全部允许角。

en.title: Ratios and inverse angles
en.summary: For a point (x,y) on a terminal arm, r is its distance from the origin.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$, sine = y/r, cosine = x/r, tangent = y/x, and reciprocals. Determine signs and every allowed angle.

concepts.title: 三角方程
concepts.summary: 先对三角比做代数运算，再求角。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 分解，保留可行比值，按周期列全分支并查端点。

en.title: Trigonometric equations
en.summary: Algebra in a ratio is followed by an angle-solving stage.

method.title: Method
method.body: Factor, retain admissible ratio roots, enumerate periodic branches and check interval endpoints.

exercises.prompt: 各角处于标准位置，终边在哪个象限？(a) $100^\circ$；(b) $500^\circ$；(c) 10；(d) $29\pi/6$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) 100° 在 90° 与 180° 之间，第二象限。(b) $500^\circ-360^\circ=140^\circ$，第二象限。(c) $10-2\pi\approx3.717$ 在 π 与 3π/2 之间，第三象限。(d) $29\pi/6-4\pi=5\pi/6$，第二象限。

en.prompt: For each angle in standard position, in which quadrant does it terminate? (a) $100^\circ$; (b) $500^\circ$; (c) 10; (d) $29\pi/6$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) 100° is between 90° and 180°: II. (b) $500^\circ-360^\circ=140^\circ$: II. (c) $10-2\pi\approx3.717$ is between π and 3π/2: III. (d) $29\pi/6-4\pi=5\pi/6$: II.

exercises.prompt: 画标准位置角，并在度与弧度之间精确换算：(a) $5\pi/2$；(b) $240^\circ$；(c) $-405^\circ$；(d) -3.5。

en.prompt: Draw each angle in standard position; convert degrees to radians and radians to degrees, exactly. (a) $5\pi/2$; (b) $240^\circ$; (c) $-405^\circ$; (d) -3.5.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) $(5\pi/2)(180^\circ/\pi)=450^\circ$: one positive turn plus 90°, terminal +y axis. (b) $240(\pi/180)=4\pi/3$: III.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (c) $-405(\pi/180)=-9\pi/4$: clockwise one turn plus 45°, terminal at 315° in IV. (d) $-3.5(180^\circ/\pi)=-630^\circ/\pi$: clockwise 3.5 rad, coterminal with $2\pi-3.5$ in II.

exercises.prompt: 度与弧度互换，必要时保留百分之一：(a) $20^\circ$；(b) $-185^\circ$；(c) -1.75；(d) $5\pi/12$。

en.prompt: Convert degrees to radians and radians to degrees; round to the nearest hundredth where needed. (a) $20^\circ$; (b) $-185^\circ$; (c) -1.75; (d) $5\pi/12$.

exercises.prompt: 求 $0^\circ\le\theta<360^\circ$ 或 $0\le\theta<2\pi$ 内同终边角，画出所在象限：(a) 6.75；(b) $400^\circ$；(c) -3；(d) $-105^\circ$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) 减 $2\pi$，得 $6.75-2\pi\approx0.467$，第一象限。(b) $400^\circ-360^\circ=40^\circ$，第一象限。(c) $-3+2\pi\approx3.283$，第三象限。(d) $-105^\circ+360^\circ=255^\circ$，第三象限。

en.prompt: Find a coterminal angle in $0^\circ\le\theta<360^\circ$ or $0\le\theta<2\pi$. Draw its quadrant. (a) 6.75; (b) $400^\circ$; (c) -3; (d) $-105^\circ$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Subtract $2\pi$: $6.75-2\pi\approx0.467$, I. (b) $400^\circ-360^\circ=40^\circ$, I. (c) $-3+2\pi\approx3.283$, III. (d) $-105^\circ+360^\circ=255^\circ$, III.

exercises.prompt: 写出全部同终边角表达式并解释变量：(a) $250^\circ$；(b) $5\pi/2$；(c) $-300^\circ$；(d) 6。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 加整数整周：度数加 $360^\circ n$，弧度加 $2\pi n$，$n\in\mathbb Z$；n = 0 包含原角。

en.prompt: Write all coterminal angles and explain your variable. (a) $250^\circ$; (b) $5\pi/2$; (c) $-300^\circ$; (d) 6.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Add integer full turns: $360^\circ n$ in degrees or $2\pi n$ in radians, $n\in\mathbb Z$. n = 0 includes the given angle.

exercises.prompt: 喷气发动机摩托车测试转速 80 000 转/分。求角速度：(a) 弧度/分；(b) 度/秒。

en.prompt: A jet-engine motorcycle is tested at 80 000 rpm. Find angular velocity in (a) radians per minute; (b) degrees per second.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) $80000(2\pi)=160000\pi$ rad/min. (b) $80000(360^\circ)/60=480000^\circ$/s. The minute-to-second conversion divides by 60.

en.prompt: $P(\theta)=(x,y)$ is the unit-circle terminal point. Give the coordinates: (a) $P(5\pi/6)$; (b) $P(-150^\circ)$; (c) $P(-11\pi/2)$; (d) $P(45^\circ)$; (e) $P(120^\circ)$; (f) $P(11\pi/3)$.

exercises.prompt: (a) 已知 $P(\pi/3)=(1/2,\sqrt3/2)$，解释如何求 $P(2\pi/3),P(4\pi/3),P(5\pi/3)$；(b) 若 $P(\theta)=(-2\sqrt2/3,1/3)$，求 $P(\theta+\pi/2)$；(c) $P(5\pi/6+\pi)$ 在哪个象限？求该 θ 与坐标。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (c) $\theta=5\pi/6+\pi=11\pi/6$，第四象限参照角 $\pi/6$，故坐标 $(\sqrt3/2,-1/2)$。

en.prompt: (a) Given $P(\pi/3)=(1/2,\sqrt3/2)$, explain how to find $P(2\pi/3),P(4\pi/3),P(5\pi/3)$. (b) If $P(\theta)=(-2\sqrt2/3,1/3)$, find $P(\theta+\pi/2)$. (c) In which quadrant is $P(5\pi/6+\pi)$? If this represents $P(\theta)$, give θ and its coordinates.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Reflect across y, origin, x respectively: $(-1/2,\sqrt3/2)$, $(-1/2,-\sqrt3/2)$, $(1/2,-\sqrt3/2)$. (b) A quarter turn sends $(x,y)\to(-y,x)$: $(-1/3,-2\sqrt2/3)$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (c) $\theta=5\pi/6+\pi=11\pi/6$, in IV, with reference $\pi/6$, so $(\sqrt3/2,-1/2)$.

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 一周基本角分别为 (a) $\pi/2$；(b) $11\pi/6$；(c) $3\pi/4$；(d) $2\pi/3$。各减 $2\pi$ 得第二个范围内角，再加减一周即越界。

en.prompt: Find all θ in $-2\pi\le\theta<2\pi$ with terminal point (a) (0,1); (b) $(\sqrt3/2,-1/2)$; (c) $(-1/\sqrt2,1/\sqrt2)$; (d) $(-1/2,\sqrt3/2)$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: One-turn angles are (a) $\pi/2$, (b) $11\pi/6$, (c) $3\pi/4$, (d) $2\pi/3$. Subtract $2\pi$ once from each to obtain the second allowed angle; another turn leaves the domain.

en.prompt: Find all θ in $-180^\circ<\theta\le360^\circ$ with terminal point (a) $(-\sqrt3/2,-1/2)$; (b) (-1,0); (c) $(-\sqrt2/2,\sqrt2/2)$; (d) $(1/2,-\sqrt3/2)$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Base angles are 210°, 180°, 135°, 300°. Subtract 360° when the result stays above -180°: (a) -150°; (b) -180° excluded; (c) -225° excluded; (d) -60°.

exercises.prompt: 若 $P(\theta)=(\sqrt5/3,-2/3)$：(a) 求 θ 并用图说明；(b) 终边在哪个象限；(c) 求 $P(\theta+\pi)$；(d) $P(\theta+\pi/2)$；(e) $P(\theta-\pi/2)$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a,b) x > 0、y < 0，射线在第四象限。令 $\alpha=\arcsin(2/3)$；一正周中 θ 为 $2\pi-\alpha\approx5.55346$ 弧度，通式为 $-\alpha+2\pi n$。

en.prompt: If $P(\theta)=(\sqrt5/3,-2/3)$: (a) find θ, explaining with a diagram; (b) identify its quadrant; (c) find $P(\theta+\pi)$; (d) $P(\theta+\pi/2)$; (e) $P(\theta-\pi/2)$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a,b) x > 0, y < 0 puts the ray in IV. Let $\alpha=\arcsin(2/3)$; θ = $2\pi-\alpha\approx5.55346$ rad in one positive turn, or $-\alpha+2\pi n$ generally.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (c) Half turn: $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$ gives $(-\sqrt5/3,2/3)$. (d) CCW quarter: $(-y,x)=(2/3,\sqrt5/3)$. (e) CW quarter: $(y,-x)=(-2/3,-\sqrt5/3)$.

exercises.prompt: 若 $\cos\theta=1/3$，$0^\circ\le\theta\le270^\circ$，求其余所有三角比，根式保留精确形式。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 该范围内正余弦只允许第一象限。单位圆 $y=\sqrt{1-(1/3)^2}=2\sqrt2/3>0$，故正弦为 $2\sqrt2/3$，正切 y/x 为 $2\sqrt2$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 取倒数并有理化：余割 $3/(2\sqrt2)=3\sqrt2/4$，正割 3，余切 $1/(2\sqrt2)=\sqrt2/4$。

en.prompt: If $\cos\theta=1/3$, $0^\circ\le\theta\le270^\circ$, find each other trigonometric ratio, in exact form when radicals occur.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Positive cosine in this domain permits I only. On the unit circle $y=\sqrt{1-(1/3)^2}=2\sqrt2/3>0$. Thus sine = $2\sqrt2/3$, tangent = y/x = $2\sqrt2$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Take reciprocals and rationalize: cosecant = $3/(2\sqrt2)=3\sqrt2/4$, secant = 3, cotangent = $1/(2\sqrt2)=\sqrt2/4$.

exercises.prompt: 不用计算器求精确值：(a) $\sin(-3\pi/2)$；(b) $\cos(3\pi/4)$；(c) $\cot(7\pi/6)$；(d) $\sec(-210^\circ)$；(e) $\tan720^\circ$；(f) $\csc300^\circ$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) -3π/2 与 π/2 同终边，正弦为 1。(b) 3π/4 在第二象限，余弦 $-\sqrt2/2$。(c) 7π/6 在第三象限，参照角 π/6，余切 $(-\sqrt3/2)/(-1/2)=\sqrt3$。

en.prompt: Without a calculator, find exact values. (a) $\sin(-3\pi/2)$; (b) $\cos(3\pi/4)$; (c) $\cot(7\pi/6)$; (d) $\sec(-210^\circ)$; (e) $\tan720^\circ$; (f) $\csc300^\circ$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) -3π/2 is coterminal with π/2, so sine = 1. (b) 3π/4 is II, so cosine = $-\sqrt2/2$. (c) 7π/6 is III with reference π/6: cotangent = $(-\sqrt3/2)/(-1/2)=\sqrt3$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (d) -210° is coterminal with 150°, cosine = $-\sqrt3/2$, so secant = $-2\sqrt3/3$. (e) 720° ends on +x: tangent = 0. (f) sine 300° = $-\sqrt3/2$, so cosecant = $-2\sqrt3/3$.

exercises.prompt: 求全部角，保留百分之一单位，并画出象限：(a) $\sin\theta=0.54$，$-2\pi<\theta\le2\pi$；(b) $\tan\theta=9.3$，$-180^\circ\le\theta<360^\circ$；(c) $\cos\theta=-0.77$，$-\pi\le\theta<\pi$；(d) $\csc\theta=9.5$，$-270^\circ<\theta\le90^\circ$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) $\alpha=\arcsin0.54=0.570437\ldots$，第一、二象限基本角为 $\alpha,\pi-\alpha$，各再减 $2\pi$，得 $-5.71,-3.71,0.57,2.57$ 弧度。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (b) $\alpha=\arctan9.3=83.862744\ldots^\circ$；正切在第一、三象限为正，每隔 180° 重复，得 $-96.14^\circ,83.86^\circ,263.86^\circ$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (c) $\beta=\arccos(-0.77)=2.449637\ldots$，第二、三象限射线在本范围表示为 $\pm\beta\approx-2.45,2.45$ 弧度。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (d) 正弦为 1/9.5，$\alpha=\arcsin(1/9.5)=6.042328\ldots^\circ$。第一、二象限射线在范围内为 $\alpha$ 与 $180^\circ-\alpha-360^\circ$，即 $6.04^\circ,-186.04^\circ$。

en.prompt: Find all approximate angles, to the nearest hundredth of a unit. Sketch the quadrants. (a) $\sin\theta=0.54$, $-2\pi<\theta\le2\pi$; (b) $\tan\theta=9.3$, $-180^\circ\le\theta<360^\circ$; (c) $\cos\theta=-0.77$, $-\pi\le\theta<\pi$; (d) $\csc\theta=9.5$, $-270^\circ<\theta\le90^\circ$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) $\alpha=\arcsin0.54=0.570437\ldots$, with I/II base angles $\alpha,\pi-\alpha$. Include each minus $2\pi$: $-5.71,-3.71,0.57,2.57$ rad.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (b) $\alpha=\arctan9.3=83.862744\ldots^\circ$; tangent positive in I/III and repeats by 180°: $-96.14^\circ,83.86^\circ,263.86^\circ$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (c) $\beta=\arccos(-0.77)=2.449637\ldots$; II/III rays give $\theta=\pm\beta\approx-2.45,2.45$ rad in this domain.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (d) Sine = 1/9.5. $\alpha=\arcsin(1/9.5)=6.042328\ldots^\circ$; I/II rays give $\alpha$ and $180^\circ-\alpha-360^\circ$, hence $6.04^\circ,-186.04^\circ$.

exercises.prompt: 求各比值，保留三位小数：(a) $\sin285^\circ$；(b) $\cot130^\circ$；(c) $\cos4.5$；(d) $\sec7.38$。

en.prompt: Find each ratio to three decimal places. (a) $\sin285^\circ$; (b) $\cot130^\circ$; (c) $\cos4.5$; (d) $\sec7.38$.

exercises.prompt: θ 的终边过 A(-3,4)。(a) 作图用量角器测角，保留整数度；(b) 求精确 $\cos\theta$；(c) 求精确 $\csc\theta+\tan\theta$；(d) 由余弦求角的度数与弧度，保留一位小数。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a,b) 在第二象限画 A，连接 O 与 A。$r=\sqrt{9+16}=5$，故 $\cos\theta=-3/5$。一周正角 $\arccos(-3/5)=126.869898\ldots^\circ$，量角器约 127°。

en.prompt: The terminal arm of θ passes through A(-3,4). (a) Draw it and use a protractor to estimate θ to the nearest degree. (b) Find exact $\cos\theta$. (c) Find exact $\csc\theta+\tan\theta$. (d) From cosine, find θ in degrees and radians to the nearest tenth.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a,b) Plot A in II and join O to A. $r=\sqrt{9+16}=5$, so $\cos\theta=-3/5$. The positive angle in one turn is $\arccos(-3/5)=126.869898\ldots^\circ$, so a protractor gives about 127°.

exercises.prompt: 因式分解：(a) $\cos^2\theta+\cos\theta$；(b) $\sin^2\theta-3\sin\theta-4$；(c) $\cot^2\theta-9$；(d) $2\tan^2\theta-9\tan\theta+10$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) 提取余弦得 $\cos\theta(\cos\theta+1)$。(b) 积 -4、和 -3，得 $(\sin\theta-4)(\sin\theta+1)$。(c) 平方差得 $(\cot\theta-3)(\cot\theta+3)$。(d) $(2\tan\theta-5)(\tan\theta-2)$ 展开为 $2\tan^2\theta-4\tan\theta-5\tan\theta+10$。

en.prompt: Factor. (a) $\cos^2\theta+\cos\theta$; (b) $\sin^2\theta-3\sin\theta-4$; (c) $\cot^2\theta-9$; (d) $2\tan^2\theta-9\tan\theta+10$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Extract cosine: $\cos\theta(\cos\theta+1)$. (b) Product -4, sum -3: $(\sin\theta-4)(\sin\theta+1)$. (c) Difference of squares: $(\cot\theta-3)(\cot\theta+3)$. (d) $(2\tan\theta-5)(\tan\theta-2)$ expands to $2\tan^2\theta-4\tan\theta-5\tan\theta+10$.

exercises.prompt: 解释为何不能求以下实数值：(a) $\sin^{-1}2$；(b) $\tan90^\circ$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) 实数角正弦在 [-1,1]，故 2 无实数反正弦值。(b) 正切 = 正弦/余弦，90° 时为 1/0，无定义。

en.prompt: Explain why it is impossible to find (a) $\sin^{-1}2$; (b) $\tan90^\circ$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Sine of a real angle is in [-1,1], so no real inverse-sine value exists for 2. (b) Tangent = sine/cosine, and at 90° it is 1/0, which is undefined.

exercises.prompt: 不求具体解，判断解数：(a) $4\cos\theta-3=0$，$0^\circ<\theta\le360^\circ$；(b) $\sin\theta+0.9=0$，$-\pi\le\theta\le\pi$；(c) $0.5\tan\theta-1.5=0$，$-180^\circ\le\theta\le0^\circ$；(d) $\csc\theta$ 无定义，$\theta\in[-2\pi,4\pi)$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) 余弦 3/4 一周两次，端点非解，故 2。(b) 正弦 -0.9 在下半圆两次，故 2。(c) 正切 3 每 180° 一解，端点非解，故 1。(d) 余割在 $n\pi$ 无定义，n = -2、-1、0、1、2、3，共 6。

en.prompt: Without solving, determine the number of solutions. (a) $4\cos\theta-3=0$, $0^\circ<\theta\le360^\circ$; (b) $\sin\theta+0.9=0$, $-\pi\le\theta\le\pi$; (c) $0.5\tan\theta-1.5=0$, $-180^\circ\le\theta\le0^\circ$; (d) $\csc\theta$ undefined, $\theta\in[-2\pi,4\pi)$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Cosine = 3/4 occurs twice in a turn; neither endpoint is a root: 2. (b) Sine = -0.9 occurs twice on the lower semicircle: 2. (c) Tangent = 3 has one solution per 180° period, endpoints nonroots: 1. (d) Cosecant undefined at $n\pi$; n = -2,-1,0,1,2,3: 6.

exercises.prompt: 求精确解：(a) $\csc\theta=\sqrt2$，$\theta\in[0^\circ,360^\circ]$；(b) $2\cos\theta+1=0$，$0\le\theta<2\pi$；(c) $3\tan\theta-\sqrt3=0$，$-180^\circ\le\theta<360^\circ$；(d) $\cot\theta+1=0$，$-\pi\le\theta<\pi$。

en.prompt: Find exact roots. (a) $\csc\theta=\sqrt2$, $\theta\in[0^\circ,360^\circ]$; (b) $2\cos\theta+1=0$, $0\le\theta<2\pi$; (c) $3\tan\theta-\sqrt3=0$, $-180^\circ\le\theta<360^\circ$; (d) $\cot\theta+1=0$, $-\pi\le\theta<\pi$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Sine = $\sqrt2/2$: 45°,135°. (b) Cosine = -1/2: $2\pi/3,4\pi/3$. (c) Tangent = $\sqrt3/3$, so $30^\circ+180^\circ n$; retain -150°,30°,210°. (d) Cotangent = -1 means tangent = -1; $-\pi/4+n\pi$ gives $-\pi/4,3\pi/4$.

exercises.prompt: 尽量精确求解，否则保留三位小数：(a) $\sin^2\theta+\sin\theta-2=0$，$0\le\theta<2\pi$；(b) $\tan^2\theta+3\tan\theta=0$，$0^\circ<\theta\le360^\circ$；(c) $6\cos^2\theta+\cos\theta=1$，$\theta\in(0^\circ,360^\circ)$；(d) $\sec^2\theta-4=0$，$\theta\in[-\pi,\pi]$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) $(\sin\theta-1)(\sin\theta+2)=0$，排除 -2，保留正弦 1，得 $\pi/2$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (b) $\tan\theta(\tan\theta+3)=0$；正切 0 得 180°、360°（排除 0°）；正切 -3 得 $180^\circ-\arctan3\approx108.435^\circ$ 与 $360^\circ-\arctan3\approx288.435^\circ$。

en.prompt: Solve exactly where possible, otherwise to the nearest thousandth. (a) $\sin^2\theta+\sin\theta-2=0$, $0\le\theta<2\pi$; (b) $\tan^2\theta+3\tan\theta=0$, $0^\circ<\theta\le360^\circ$; (c) $6\cos^2\theta+\cos\theta=1$, $\theta\in(0^\circ,360^\circ)$; (d) $\sec^2\theta-4=0$, $\theta\in[-\pi,\pi]$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) $(\sin\theta-1)(\sin\theta+2)=0$; reject -2, keep sine = 1: $\pi/2$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (b) $\tan\theta(\tan\theta+3)=0$; tangent = 0 gives 180°,360° (exclude 0°); tangent = -3 gives $180^\circ-\arctan3\approx108.435^\circ$ and $360^\circ-\arctan3\approx288.435^\circ$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (c) $(3\cos\theta-1)(2\cos\theta+1)=0$. Cosine = 1/3 gives 70.529°,289.471°; cosine = -1/2 gives exact 120°,240°.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (d) Secant = ±2 means cosine = ±1/2. Retain $-2\pi/3,-\pi/3,\pi/3,2\pi/3$; neither ±π is a root.

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 全部根为 $\pi/3+2\pi n$ 或 $2\pi/3+2\pi n$，即 $60^\circ+360^\circ n$ 或 $120^\circ+360^\circ n$。在最外所求根与下个不需要的根之间选端点。

en.prompt: Give a domain where $\sin\theta=\sqrt3/2$ has exactly these solutions. (a) $\pi/3,2\pi/3$; (b) $-5\pi/3,-4\pi/3,\pi/3$; (c) $-660^\circ,-600^\circ,-300^\circ,-240^\circ$; (d) $-240^\circ,60^\circ,120^\circ,420^\circ$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: All roots are $\pi/3+2\pi n$ or $2\pi/3+2\pi n$, equivalently $60^\circ+360^\circ n$ or $120^\circ+360^\circ n$. Choose endpoints between the requested extreme roots and the next unwanted roots.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Examples: (a) $[0,\pi]$; (b) $[-2\pi,\pi/2]$; (c) $[-720^\circ,-180^\circ]$; (d) $[-240^\circ,420^\circ]$. Listing the periodic branches inside each confirms exactly the required roots.

exercises.prompt: 按指定单位求通解：(a) $\sin x=-1/2$，弧度；(b) $\sin x=\sin^2x$，度；(c) $\sec x+2=0$，度；(d) $(\tan x-1)(\tan x-\sqrt3)=0$，弧度。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) 负正弦在第三、四象限，基本角 $7\pi/6,11\pi/6$，加 $2\pi n$。(b) $\sin x(\sin x-1)=0$，得 $x=180^\circ n$ 或 $90^\circ+360^\circ n$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (c) 正割 -2 即余弦 -1/2，得 $x=120^\circ+360^\circ n$ 或 $240^\circ+360^\circ n$。(d) 正切为 1 或 √3，周期 π，得 $x=\pi/4+n\pi$ 或 $\pi/3+n\pi$；所有 n 为整数。

exercises.answer: (a) $7\pi/6+2\pi n$ or $11\pi/6+2\pi n$; (b) $180^\circ n$ or $90^\circ+360^\circ n$; (c) $120^\circ+360^\circ n$ or $240^\circ+360^\circ n$; (d) $\pi/4+\pi n$ or $\pi/3+\pi n$; $n\in\mathbb Z$.

en.prompt: Find each general solution in the specified units. (a) $\sin x=-1/2$, radians; (b) $\sin x=\sin^2x$, degrees; (c) $\sec x+2=0$, degrees; (d) $(\tan x-1)(\tan x-\sqrt3)=0$, radians.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Negative sine gives III,IV base angles $7\pi/6,11\pi/6$, add $2\pi n$. (b) $\sin x(\sin x-1)=0$ gives $x=180^\circ n$ or $90^\circ+360^\circ n$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (c) Secant = -2 means cosine = -1/2; $x=120^\circ+360^\circ n$ or $240^\circ+360^\circ n$. (d) Tangent = 1 or √3, with period π: $x=\pi/4+n\pi$ or $\pi/3+n\pi$. All n are integers.

en.answer: (a) $7\pi/6+2\pi n$ or $11\pi/6+2\pi n$; (b) $180^\circ n$ or $90^\circ+360^\circ n$; (c) $120^\circ+360^\circ n$ or $240^\circ+360^\circ n$; (d) $\pi/4+\pi n$ or $\pi/3+\pi n$; $n\in\mathbb Z$.
